rationale: The proposed topology improves the S21 gain margin by adding a source degeneration inductor in series with the NMOS transistor's source, which increases input impedance match and enhances gain through improved transconductance efficiency. This targeted change directly addresses the binding failure in S21_db (currently -0.029 dB vs required 14 dB) without affecting other constraints, as the added inductor provides additional tuning freedom for impedance matching and gain enhancement within the 5.8 GHz band. The inductor also maintains stability and keeps the device count within budget.
